claims.claim: I think what I meant was that, despite being surrounded by strangers, there's this shared experience of daily routines that makes me feel a bit more connected. Like, when I heard the coffee grinder downstairs, it was this loud noise that I was annoyed by at first, but then I realized someone else was just trying to start their day like me. It's little moments like those that make the building feel less isolating.
